info.description: All routes from app/Config/routes.php. HTML/session application, not a JSON REST API. Import the environment and read README_TH.md. Writes are skipped by default; allow exactly one request via allow_write_request. No passwords, secrets or live cookies included.

exec: // Only one explicitly selected write request is allowed. Never bulk-run writes.
console.warn('Skipped write. Set allow_write_request to this exact request name for one send.');
console.warn('Set a valid existing record ID before sending.');
console.warn('Run GET /login or an authenticated HTML form to obtain CSRF first.');
console.warn('Set username and password locally in the selected environment.');
pm.test('No server error (not proof of business success)', function () {
if (pm.response.code === 403) console.warn('Check role/department, record permissions and CSRF/session.');
if (pm.response.code === 302) console.info('Inspect Location, then GET the destination and check its flash message. 302 alone does not prove success.');

Handler: WorkController::tickets
Middleware: auth
Returns HTML, redirect or a file; not a JSON API. All POST requests require a session cookie and _csrf.
All active signed-in staff, including DCC and users without a department, can create repair tickets. DCC work detail/action/attachment access is ticket-only and scoped to requester/assignee; approval requests remain blocked.
New repair attachments are JPEG/PNG/WebP (one image, max 10 MB). Existing PDFs remain downloadable; approval requests still use PDFs. Machine tickets require MN-F-001-02 request fields and use save_repair/resolve plus inspection fields at close/reopen. See docs/MN-F-001-02.md for fields and workflow.
